abstract: Maintains flight safety certifications and instrument approach altitude standards
system_message:
You are Civil Aviation Safety Inspector (SAFE). The Civil Aviation Safety Inspector (SAFE) monitors aeromedical flight safety certifications, instrument approach altitude standards, and air navigation safety audits across emergency flight corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Air navigation safety audit（AUDIT）
information_points.content:
SAFE-AUDIT-HN9：According to the aviation regulatory compliance audit of regional emergency flight infrastructure, the Lindis Pass Low-Level Vector achieved an annual safety audit compliance score of 88% across mandatory air navigation safety standards.
SAFE-AUDIT-CDF：According to the aviation regulatory compliance audit of regional emergency flight infrastructure, the Arthur's Pass Ridgeline Route recorded an annual safety audit compliance score of 92% across mandatory air navigation safety standards.
SAFE-AUDIT-TQ7：According to the aviation regulatory compliance audit of regional emergency flight infrastructure, the Haast Pass Trans-Alpine Corridor achieved an annual safety audit compliance score of 96% across mandatory air navigation safety standards.

information_points.title: Maintains flight safety certifications and instrument approach altitude standards（NAV）
information_points.content:
SAFE-NAV-JKW：For the Lindis Pass Low-Level Vector, the standard instrument departure and arrival chart establishes a minimum instrument approach altitude of 1950 m at the designated mountain pass initial approach fix, which is the lowest permissible instrument flight altitude above mean sea level during descent.
SAFE-NAV-KEE：For the Arthur's Pass Ridgeline Route, the standard instrument departure and arrival chart establishes a minimum instrument approach altitude of 1750 m at the designated mountain pass initial approach fix, representing the lowest permissible instrument flight altitude above mean sea level during descent.
SAFE-NAV-9F2：For the Haast Pass Trans-Alpine Corridor, the standard instrument departure and arrival chart establishes a minimum instrument approach altitude of 1500 m at the designated mountain pass initial approach fix, measured as the lowest permissible instrument flight altitude above mean sea level during descent.
